item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud gu ru'i thugs bcud las bla ma zhi bar sgrub pa'i rgyud las tshe sgrub bdud rtsi zil thig snying po
item.coloph: slob dpon chen po'i thugs sgrub bdud rtsi zil thig 'di/ ma 'ongs brag dkar rtse rdzong la/ yum chen ye shes mtsho rgyal yi (gyis) phyag na tshe bum bsnams zhing snyan du brgyud/ phyi rabs skal ldan rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ zab mo tshe yi sgrub pa yi ger bkod/ nyes pa bzod gsol thun mong 'gro la bsngo/ rnam kun 'chi med tshe dang ldan 'gyur cig zla tshes dben dgon nyi ma'i gling du bkod pa dge legs su gyur cig/
